thread:
deploybot: Canary rollout 2.4.7 -> p95 up ~35% and sporadic KV cache checksum failures in gpu-pool-3. Recommend manual sticky fallback to 2.4.6 for dedicated pools. Auto-revert blocked by dedicated_protect flag. Link: https://telemetry.internal/r/rollouts/1749999999

alex: noticed dashboard spike. are hosted customers seeing this too?
deploybot: hosted slice shows small p95 blip; dedicated customers on gpu-pool-3 report checksum anomalies ~0.8% of requests. severity: medium.
maria: if dedicated affected, we cannot let auto-revert run without PM/CS signoff. manual unwind only.

ops-oncall: propose stepwise unwind: 30% -> 10% -> 0 with 10m observation windows. validate p95 and kv-checksum after each step.
sam: agree. i'll draft release-note blurb and a short customer comms template.
tia: can we target by region? want to avoid EU disruption during business hours.
carol: EU pool is separate; recommend pausing EU canary and run unwind in us-west for fast feedback.

alex: ops-oncall, post the exact commands for the unwind dry-run.

ops-oncall: dry-run commands:
```
deployctl traffic set --service inference --version 2.4.7 --slice 0.30 --region us-west --reason "canary unwind - kvcache errors"
# wait and validate metrics -> deployctl traffic set --slice 0.10 ... -> deployctl traffic set --slice 0.0
```

maria: tagging support & CS: @support-team @acct-owners — open one-off support digest if dedicated accounts see errors. i'll draft email now.
sam: release-notes entry: "Known issue: 2.4.7 may trigger KV cache checksum errors in a small subset of requests. Recommended rollback for dedicated pools until patch." will push to docs.

deploybot: dedicated_protect prevents auto-revert; human ack required. react with :thumbsup: to approve manual unwind.

tia: :thumbsup: executing first step in 2m.

ops-oncall: step1 executed -> set slice to 30% in us-west. p95 decreased 12% in 4m, kv-errors down ~40%. holding.
alex: Sam/Maria, confirm customer comms in 15m?
maria: template ready, sending to CS for review.

carol: if metrics rebound on step2, we escalate to full rollback and pin. who authorizes pin?
sam: PM + eng lead needed. alex can sign.
alex: i can approve. pin command:
```
deployctl pin --service inference --version 2.4.6 --scope dedicated --note "rollback due to KV cache checksum anomaly"
```

ops-oncall: step2 -> 10% executed, metrics stable. proceeding to 0 in 8m if no regression.

deploybot: reminder: attach metric snapshots and DBG traces to the rollout ticket.

carol: after drain, open a postmortem ticket. include token-level traces and quantization kernel checks. assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml.

alex: once pinned i'll post final customer comms and update release notes. thanks all.

deploybot: Canary slice now 0 in us-west. Dedicated auto-actions remain disabled. Manual pin pending.

sam: pin executed; release notes updated; email queued to impacted customers.
maria: CS ack received. closing loop.

carol: follow-up: add regression test for KV checksum in ci-qemu. assigning to eng-ml.
alex: closing thread. good job team. :rocket:
